$comment: The venue register: how a calendar's free-text location becomes a named place with coordinates and — when the place is a parcel the site documents — the path of its page. fetch.py matches an event's location string against each key and each `match` entry (normalized: lowercase, alphanumeric-only, substring), longest matcher first. `path` is set only where the venue IS the documented parcel — an event at a park or plaza that has no page still gets a dot and a listing, just no panel and no link. `lat`/`lng` fall back to the page's coordinates when `path` is set; set both when a named venue sits inside a bigger parcel (e.g. the Bandshell inside Golden Gate Park). `note` records where the coordinates came from, so a coordinate here is a cited fact like any other.

sunset dunes.name: Sunset Dunes
sunset dunes.note: The park is the former Upper Great Highway; parcels/acdm-wktn puts the Noriega stretch on parcel 2001032, the 1754 Great Highway page. The roadbed is mostly unparceled ROW, so the venue pin stays the OSM centroid; per-event coordinates from sunsetdunes.org override it.

alemany farm.name: Alemany Farm
alemany farm.note: Nature in the City's own event pin for the farm; Nominatim puts '700 Alemany Boulevard' at 37.7331,-122.4197 — same footprint. No EAS address on Alemany itself, but parcels/acdm-wktn puts the farm inside parcel 5801002, the 95 Justin Drive page.

united nations plaza.name: United Nations Plaza
united nations plaza.note: EAS resolves '50 United Nations Plaza' to parcel 0351050 — the parcel the 10–50 United Nations Plaza page documents. Coordinates are the page's own.

city hall.name: City Hall
city hall.note: EAS resolves '1 Dr Carlton B Goodlett Place' to parcel 0787001 — the City Hall page. RecPark's 'City Hall Room 416 - 1 Dr. Carlton B. Goodlett Place' matches on 'city hall'.

randall museum.name: Randall Museum
randall museum.note: EAS resolves '199 Museum Way' to parcel 2615002 — the Randall Museum page. Coordinates are the page's own.

golden gate bandshell.name: Golden Gate Bandshell
golden gate bandshell.note: EAS resolves '75 Hagiwara Tea Garden Drive' to parcel 1700001, the Golden Gate Park parcel the 6101–6701 Fulton page documents — the Bandshell sits inside it. The pin itself is Nominatim 'Spreckels Temple of Music' (the Bandshell's formal name) on Music Concourse Drive, checked 2026-09; the parcel's address point is miles west and must not be used.

mclaren lodge.name: McLaren Lodge
mclaren lodge.note: Same Golden Gate Park parcel 1700001 as the Bandshell — but the pin is the lodge itself, Nominatim 'McLaren Lodge' at the Stanyan edge of the park, checked 2026-09.

hagiwara tea garden.name: Golden Gate Bandshell
hagiwara tea garden.note: Illuminate lists the Bandshell by its street address '75 Hagiwara Tea Garden Dr' — same venue as 'golden gate bandshell' above.

147 fulton.name: Fulton Street Plaza
147 fulton.note: Illuminate's own event page links this exact pin for '147 Fulton St' — the plaza beside the Main Library. No matching parcel page on the site.

east meadow.name: 14th Avenue East Meadow, Golden Gate Park
east meadow.note: Illuminate's own event page links this exact pin. parcels/acdm-wktn puts the meadow inside Golden Gate Park parcel 1700001 — the 6101 Fulton page, same as the Bandshell and McLaren Lodge.

union square.name: Union Square
union square.note: OpenStreetMap centroid (nominatim 'Union Square, San Francisco'), checked 2026-09. The plaza is parcel 0308001 — documented at 333 Post Street.

sigmund stern grove.name: Sigmund Stern Grove
sigmund stern grove.note: OpenStreetMap centroid (nominatim 'Sigmund Stern Grove'), checked 2026-09. The park is parcel 2488001 — the 2899 19th Avenue page.

civic center plaza.name: Civic Center Plaza
civic center plaza.note: OpenStreetMap centroid (nominatim 'Civic Center Plaza'), checked 2026-09. The plaza is parcel 0788001 — documented at 355 McAllister Street, one of its addresses.

rochambeau playground.name: Rochambeau Playground
rochambeau playground.note: OpenStreetMap centroid (nominatim 'Rochambeau Playground'), checked 2026-09. The playground is parcel 1384006 — the 250 25th Avenue page.

mcateer campus.name: McAteer Campus
mcateer campus.note: The campus is parcel 7560003 — the 555 Portola Drive page. Coordinates are the event listing's own pin.

palou phelps.name: Palou Phelps Mini Park
palou phelps.note: The mini park is parcel 5320009 — the 1848 Palou Avenue page. Coordinates are the event listing's own pin.

adah's stairway.name: Adah's Stairway
adah's stairway.note: A stairway in the public right of way — parcels/acdm-wktn finds no parcel at the pin, so the venue lists and draws a dot but links no page.

moraga tiled steps.name: Moraga Tiled Steps
moraga tiled steps.note: The 16th Avenue Tiled Steps at Moraga — a stairway in the public right of way with no parcel (parcels/acdm-wktn), so no page path. Coordinates are the event listing's own pin.

698 connecticut.name: 698 Connecticut Street
698 connecticut.note: EAS resolves '698 Connecticut St' to this parcel point. RecPark lists block parties by street address; the event is the block, not a parcel the site documents, so no page path.

mission st and avalon.name: Mission Street & Avalon Avenue
mission st and avalon.note: Sunday Streets intersection in the Excelsior; no reliable coordinate source found yet — events here list on /events but draw no map dot.

balboa park.name: Balboa Park
balboa park.note: OpenStreetMap centroid (nominatim 'Balboa Park, San Francisco'), checked 2026-09.
